questions.de: Welche aufgelöste Band formierte sich 1993 neu, um beim offiziellen Ball zu Bill Clintons Amtseinführung zu spielen?
questions.en: Which disbanded band re-formed in 1993 to play at the official ball for Bill Clinton's inauguration?

timeline.labelEn: Fleetwood Mac's classic line-up reunites to play for Bill Clinton's first inauguration
timeline.labelDe: Die klassische Besetzung von Fleetwood Mac tritt zu Bill Clintons erster Amtseinführung wieder zusammen auf

questions.notes: Strictly the classic 1974–1987 line-up reunited; the band itself had not formally disbanded. Clinton had used 'Don't Stop' as his campaign song.

questions.cardDe: In welcher europäischen Stadt befindet sich das weltweit älteste Naturkundemuseum?
questions.de: In welcher europäischen Stadt befindet sich das weltweit älteste Naturkundemuseum?
questions.en: In which European city is the world's oldest natural history museum?

timeline.labelEn: Grand Duke Ferdinando I de' Medici founds the natural history museum of the University of Pisa
timeline.labelDe: Großherzog Ferdinando I. de' Medici gründet das Naturkundemuseum der Universität Pisa

source.title: Museo di storia naturale dell'Università di Pisa – Wikipedia

questions.notes: The 'oldest' claim is contested: the Pisa museum (founded 1591, formalised 1595/96; today in Calci near Pisa) is the oldest still existing one usually cited; Francesco Calzolari's private museum in Verona (documented 1554) and Conrad Gessner's in Zürich were earlier but no longer exist. The card's own answer could not be verified.
